operation.body:
### Goal

Implement **FR-006**: reject invalid requests for missing feedback records without corrupting stored data, and keep the user able to recover and continue.

### Acceptance criteria

- `show` and `update` for a non-existent feedback id respond safely (no 500 / unhandled `ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound`); stored rows are unchanged.
- After a missing-record response, the user can reach the inbox and submit new feedback via the normal creation flow (integration coverage).
- Invalid category updates remain covered; do not regress existing FR-003/FR-004 behaviour or tests.
- Run `bin/rails test`, `bash tests/test-adapter.sh`, and `./scripts/check-workflow-leak.sh`; report results in the PR validation section.
- Do not implement FR-007 breadth expansion, FR-008 sample dataset/docs pass, or edits to `docs/security-review.md`.

### Constraints

Parent project authorization is `self-correcting-review auto-merge`. Inherit eligible auto-merge when preconditions are met. Branch name must include `issue-<n>`. Keep the change reviewable in one PR.

### Out of scope

Authentication, production deployment, CI workflow redesign, unrelated documentation churn, and broad test-suite refactors beyond FR-006 boundaries.

### Relevant context

FR-001–FR-005 are on `main` (goals #12, #14, #16, #18, #20; PRs #13, #15, #17, #19, #21). Invalid category handling already exists in `FeedbacksController#update` and integration tests; missing-record paths for `show`/`update` still raise. See `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md` FR-006 and acceptance details.
